svg.text: Social94: Cross-Platform AI-Powered Social Media Analytics
A Decoupled Architecture Utilizing Next.js, Flutter, Firebase, and Google Gemini LLMs

text.tspan: Social media marketing is heavily reliant on algorithmic distribution, prioritizing
"Audience Reach" and "Engagement" over static follower counts. Independent
creators face a highly fragmented data ecosystem restricted by closed APIs.
Through extensive user research, we identified "blank page syndrome" and
"data fatigue" as the top two bottlenecks for content creators today.
Social94 (The Product) aggregates this fragmented cross-platform data and
applies generative LLMs natively to provide predictive analytics, copy generation,
and actionable insights through a simplified, user-friendly interface.

g.text: Platforms actively prevent open data sharing.
Tools like Hootsuite target large corporate teams.
Dashboards are flooded with irrelevant metrics like
CRM funnels instead of simple audience reach and content health.
Most affordable creator tools lack native LLM integration.
Initialized Next.js (App Router) and Flutter codebases. Setup Monorepo.
Linked both clients to a single scalable Firebase backend.
Established UserStats and Post schemas in NoSQL Firestore.
Built real-time syncing via StreamBuilder (Flutter) and React hooks.
Integrated Gemini API with multi-modal prompt engineering.
Built pipelines for content analysis, copy generation, and trend insights.
Built API routes to parse meta tags/JSON-LD for IG, YT, TikTok.
Provides centralized orchestration for both Web and Mobile clients.

text.tspan: Rather than a generic chatbot interface, AI is baked into specialized Next.js
API routes utilizing the Gemini 1.5 API.
// The problem: LLMs return unpredictable free-form text.
// The solution: Enforce strict JSON schema in the system prompt.
const prompt = `Analyze this post. Return strictly this JSON:
"score": <number 0-100>,
"sentiment": "<positive/neutral/negative>",
"hashtags": [<5 relevant hashtags string array>],
"improvements": ["<actionable advice 1>", "<advice 2>"]
Multimodal Analysis: The system handles both text and images.
Users upload a draft image, the Next.js route converts it to Base64, appends
it as `inlineData`, and Gemini analyzes the visual layout alongside caption text.
Resiliency: AI endpoints frequently timeout. A custom wrapper function
(`generateWithRetry`) implements exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s).
Because Official APIs are inaccessible to solo developers/startups,
Social94 uses tailored web scraping routes via Next.js backend.

g.text: Fallback: Parses embedded JSON-LD schema objects.
Tested boundary inputs (malformed JSON, empty fields)
for each Next.js API route before integration.
Tested complete data flow: Web Input -> API -> Firestore -> Flutter.
Verified Real-time State Replication Success Rate: 99.8%
Re-tested legacy features (Auth) before starting new sprints.
UAT confirmed high praise for multimodal AI workflows,
but noted scraper fragility against aggressive anti-bot systems.
